aria-hidden only hides content from assistive tech, not visually — it must still be rendered

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><div aria-hidden=\"true\">still shown</div><p>also visible</p>")
IO.inspect(result)
```
